name: velvet-star
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: A single transparent PNG 3D tactile symbol used to replace one letter in playful portfolio typography at 48–72px.
Scene/backdrop: Truly transparent background with real alpha channel. The empty surrounding area must be alpha 0; no solid backdrop and no simulated checkerboard.
Style/medium: Premium photorealistic tactile 3D render, friendly oversized inflated pillow volume, handmade material micro-detail, soft directional studio light from upper left, restrained ambient occlusion only on the object.
Composition/framing: One centered symbol only, square image, tight framing with about 8 percent clear margin, near frontal camera with slight 3D rotation so volume is visible and silhouette is instantly readable. Complete object, never cropped.
Constraints: Crisp clean silhouette and clean transparent edges, no shadow plane, no ground, no cast shadow outside the object, no supports, no strings, no extra objects, no faces, no text or captions, no watermark.
Subject: A periwinkle blue plump five-lobed star pillow. Five broad rounded lobes with gently pinched valleys, not sharp points. Rich short-pile velvet with delicate fabric grain, soft blue highlights and darker cobalt shading at the lower left, subtly visible stitched perimeter seam, gently asymmetric organic stuffing. Friendly chunky blob-star silhouette.
